method: Static first reasoned review: atomscan slow before/after, cleave facts including decoded strings, rizin disassembly and manual control/data-flow tracing. Samples were never executed. Scores, trait labels, collector filenames and earlier review records were treated as leads, not proof.

samples.identification: StormAttack / Shtormec-style damaged x86 DLL injector
evidence: Entry 0x402674 enters dispatcher 0x401cb0. Mode DWORD at file 0x4120 is 3: 0x401f8a calls Active Setup installer 0x401900, then 0x401f8f calls self-delete routine 0x401390.

Installer registers an HKLM Active Setup Installed Components GUID and expandable StubPath, reads its own image with CRT file I/O, patches and writes a copy, and launches it with CreateProcessA. Cleanup uses its module pathname, GetShortPathNameA, COMSPEC and /c del with CreateProcessA/ResumeThread.
Alternative mode 1 deletes and replaces LanmanServer/Parameters/ServiceDLL at 0x401320 and 0x40133e. Resource extraction 0x402460 chains Find/Sizeof/Load/LockResource to writer 0x4023c0.

Injector 0x401150 selects calc, notepad or Internet Explorer, creates a child, allocates remote memory, writes the DLL pathname, resolves Kernel32!LoadLibraryA and passes its returned address plus the remote path buffer to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d.

The Storm ddos Server and Welcome to use storm ddos banners corroborate StormAttack lineage. The surviving installation and injection code, service hijack and cleanup tip the verdict, independent of sandbox scores.
samples.limits: The 40032-byte resource region is entirely zero-filled, so no DLL can be extracted from it. The 256-byte .hf section is writable/executable high-entropy data; no surviving direct branch from the outer text enters it. Bound/import-table damage and self-copy patch offsets constrain runtime success. No ransomware encryption or WannaCry behavior is established. The only decoded string is a printf GUID template mechanically percent-decoded by the extractor; it is not a network endpoint.
samples.marker_line: StormAttack loader: persistence and injection; traits retained

samples.identification: macOS AppleScript credential stealer and wallet replacer, Python carrier
evidence: Module-level subprocess.run executes /usr/bin/osascript -e with the complete raw AppleScript payload. This is executable carrier content, not an unused source quotation.

A System Preferences titled, masked password dialog repeats dscl . authonly checks until authentication succeeds. The entered password is used for local verification only; these bytes do not save, upload or replay it to sudo.
Queries Chrome Safe Storage with security find-generic-password, writes the returned key to /tmp/osalogging/storage.txt, then copies Keychain databases, ~/.aws and ~/.ssh into that directory.

If Trezor Suite exists, downloads and unzips a remote archive, overwrites the installed app.asar and Info.plist, forcefully ad-hoc signs the app, and clears extended attributes. It does not launch the replacement app.

ditto -c -k creates /tmp/osalogging.zip and curl -X PUT --data-binary sends that same archive to the remote /gate endpoint. Deceptive capture, unrelated secret collection, installed-wallet substitution and linked export establish malicious intent.
samples.limits: No original upstream package or deployment history is supplied. Remote wallet-resource retrieval failed with HTTP 521 in both atomscan and forager; no replacement archive or final payload is invented. Cancelled dialogs, missing stores or failed shell commands can stop the unguarded script. No root privilege escalation or browser database decryption is present.
samples.marker_line: macOS stealer carrier: phishes and uploads secrets; expand coverage

evidence: Go 1.25.5 Windows GUI PE, stripped with -H windowsgui -s -w. Go buildinfo declares atotto/clipboard v0.1.4 and x/sys v0.15.0. The compiled dependencies are ordinary libraries; the hostile policy is in main-package code.

main at 0x1400f8060 first calls antiSandbox then isDebuggerPresent. The latter invokes kernel32!IsDebuggerPresent, tests DEBUG/VSDEBUG/__COMPAT_LAYER variables, and searches its own executable name for debugger/tool words. This is not a running-process enumeration.
antiSandbox requests 100ms sleep and exits if time.Since is below 50ms. The debugger-positive path sleeps 30 seconds and exits.

isAdmin opens PhysicalDrive0 read-only; on failure main builds a hidden PowerShell Start-Process request using -Verb RunAs and exits. This requests normal UAC consent; no UAC bypass or raw-disk destruction is established.
main hands function descriptors 0x140153960 and 0x140153968 to the Go newproc routine 0x14004a5e0. They point to createBackupCopies and installPersistence; a third goroutine enters monitorClipboard.

createBackupCopies reads os.Executable with os.ReadFile, constructs random EXE paths under System32, SysWOW64, APPDATA/Microsoft/Windows and TEMP, appends random hex text to its own bytes, writes copies when the C: free-space check permits, and invokes attrib +h on each path. Only the hidden attribute is requested.

installRegistryPersistence writes its own executable path under HKCU and HKLM CurrentVersion/Run using randomized security/system-like value names. installScheduledTask invokes schtasks /create /tn <name> /tr <own-image> /sc hourly /st 00:00 /f. installStartupFolder joins APPDATA, Microsoft, Windows, Start Menu, Programs and Startup and formats a WScript.Shell CreateShortcut/TargetPath/Save PowerShell body targeting its own image.

monitorClipboard runs a 500ms ticker, reads clipboard text, skips unchanged content, trims it and checks ^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$. On a match, it calls getEncryptedAddress then clipboard.writeAll with the returned string. The replacement is computed by Base64 decoding 60 bytes and XORing every decoded byte with 0x55.

The actual replacement is 45 bytes with hex 7f6a482b7d7a69287f4b6a297f486b2e7f49682e7f4f6e247f4e692c7f4f6e2d7f4c6f227f4d6c237f426d207f. It is not an Ethereum address. The attempted address-pattern overwrite is still hostile clipboard corruption; successful payment diversion is not asserted.
samples.limits: No original repository, user authorization, distribution wrapper or deployment history is supplied. No ransomware, miner, industrial-control, Sliver or network exfiltration behavior was established. Runtime success is not asserted, particularly for the malformed clipboard replacement.

corrections.change: Renamed the path fact to macos-keychain-db-reference without changing its matcher. Renamed the validated-prompt co-occurrences; retained them as suspicious. Added a hostile acquisition rule requiring phishing plus an actual cp command or the keychain call and readwrite file-copy scaffold.
corrections.evidence: The original carrier never saves or sends loginPassword. The no-copy Keychain/password control previously fired the hostile theft rule and now has no hostile theft finding. The independent index.applescript fixture retains seven hostile findings, replacing the weak theft rule with the stronger acquisition rule.

corrections.change: Moved the identical matcher, type/platform gates, confidence and size bound into micro-behaviors/communications/http/curl::python-curl-data-binary-command. Updated its exact TeamPCP consumer and removed the inherited supply-chain ATT&CK mapping from the neutral operation.

consumer_audit.keychain: All renamed exact references were updated. Added keychain grouping does not satisfy a multi-source threshold: the two keychain-ancestor consumers use an any-of-one indicator set and an exclusion, respectively; neither counts it toward an independent-source threshold. Existing exclusion behavior remains unchanged.
consumer_audit.registry: The moved policy-state OR remains an exact input to executionpolicy-registry-tamper. The registry ancestor selector belongs to a resource-profile rule; lexical words no longer provide false registry evidence.
consumer_audit.vendor_and_family: Recorded all affected ancestor selectors in scratch/current-batch/ancestor-consumers.json. Exact ShellObject and TeamPCP consumers retain their matching populations. New language/vendor-reference memberships establish words or references only, not trusted provenance.

verification.source_controls: 8 Python-carrier, local-staging, backup, Keychain-reference, helper-without-copy and curl controls passed.
verification.binary_controls: 7 original-PE and byte/operand controls passed; changing schtasks, /create, hourly, the Startup RIP operand, the array slot or the Bypass operand removes only the intended added observation while preserving the clipper.
verification.external_controls: Independent index.applescript retains all seven hostile behaviors with the acquisition-rule replacement. Elex resource-dropper fixture retains all three hostile findings. Two compiled benign Go controls have no hostile findings; actual policy flags remain notable in the opt-in autorun example.
verification.comparison_scope: Compared atomscan with the same follow setting before/after. Python follow performs an additional merged-report evaluation even when the referenced URL fails; disabling it omits some unchanged engine-derived umbrella findings. Those reporting differences are not YAML coverage losses. The three original samples have one analyzed unit each and no available embedded archive members; the wallet URL failed with 521.
verification.coverage_losses: No supported hostile behavior was lost in the samples or external positive controls. Removed misleading login/password-export, family, policy-state and provenance claims; retained their supported observations or stronger replacements.
verification.classifier: All three remain HOSTILE and agree with the reasoned MALICIOUS verdicts. No remaining classifier miss is exposed. The scanner reports a pre-existing feature-v19/model-v18 compatibility warning; rules were not adjusted to influence model probability.
verification.final_required_check: make validate, after writing the judgement markers; any stale inline-YARA precompile fingerprint is handled only if reported.

external_sources.scope: Microsoft corroborates the StormServer.dll/LanmanServer ServiceDLL and IE-injection lineage. Its driver-overwrite, anti-AV and C2 claims are not transferred to the erased-resource specimen. The supplied tria.ge and VirusTotal pages were inaccessible through the web tool.
